## Depreciation {#fm5-depreciation .fm-slide }

An asset loses a percentage of its **current value** each period.

A 14% decrease retains:

$$100\%-14\%=86\%\qquad\text{multiplier }0.86$$

**Predict:** if the percentage loss stays the same, does the dollar loss stay the same?

::: notes
Booklet §4.2, p. 13. The dollar loss decreases as the value decreases. Use a single-period change first, then let the hinge check the repeated multiplier. Avoid introducing straight-line depreciation as if it were the booklet's model.
:::
